scope: CalculateBaseDamage only: pre-STAB, pre-effectiveness, pre-random final damage. Fixed link-rule fixtures disable badge bonuses; they are not campaign play.
defaults: Level50, all five battle stats100, neutral stages6, HP90/90, no item or ability, Pound40. Integer divisions truncate at each stated step. GenIII class depends on move type.

cases.derivation: Water is special; equal100 special stats give17+2.
Fire uses special stats despite contact: floor(22*60*50/100/50)+2 =13+2.
GenIII Dark uses special stats: floor(22*60*50/100/50)+2 =13+2.
Neutral17 intermediate is halved by burn before+2: floor(17/2)+2.
Guts makes Attack150 and suppresses burn's damage reduction: floor(22*40*150/100/50)+2 =26+2.
Attack doubles to200: floor(22*40*200/100/50)+2 =35+2.
Reflect halves neutral17 before+2: floor(17/2)+2.
Two defending battlers use the GenIII screen rounding: 2*floor(17/3)+2 =12.
Defending ally absent selects single-defender screen: floor(17/2)+2 =10.
Critical context ignores negative attack and positive defense stages; neutral17+2. Actual critical multiplier is applied outside this function.
Keep Attack200 and Defense50: floor(22*40*200/50/50)+2 =70+2; final critical multiplier is outside scope.
Attack50 and Defense200 give floor(22*40*50/200/50)+2 =4+2.
Physical intermediate truncates to0, clamps to1, then this function adds2. Final damage/randomness is outside scope.
ThickFat halves effective special attack to50: floor(22*40*50/100/50)+2 =8+2.
Screen halves special neutral17 before+2: floor(17/2)+2.
Rain halves Fire intermediate17: floor(17/2)+2.
Rain multiplies Water intermediate17 by1.5: floor(17*15/10)+2 =25+2.
Sun multiplies Fire intermediate17 by1.5: floor(17*15/10)+2.
Sun halves Water intermediate17: floor(17/2)+2.
At30/90 HP Blaze changes power40 to60: floor(22*60/50)+2 =26+2.
31/90 is above the one-third threshold, so power stays40 and damage19.
Power75 gives intermediate33; two-target spread halves it before+2: floor(33/2)+2 =18.
One defending target remains, so spread reduction is absent: floor(22*75/50)+2 =33+2.
